name: Mironshoh Inomjonov
description: Research Engineer at tilmoch.ai. Interested in NLP, multimodal and representation learning.
bio:
I'm a MSc/PhD student at Sungkyunkwan University (SKKU) where I am mainly conducting research on VLMs under supervision of Prof. Tamer Abuhmed.
Member of [InfoLab](https://infolab-skku.github.io/)

Before tilmoch.ai I worked on computer vision and speech at [Vention](https://ventionteams.com/), and on applied ML systems at [KPI.com](https://kpi.com/). I hold a BSc in Software Engineering from [New Uzbekistan University](https://newuu.uz/), on a Presidential scholarship.
researchIntro: I'm interested in NLP, multimodal and representation learning.

research.title: Filling the Gap for Uzbek: Creating Translation Resources for Southern Uzbek
research.description: Southern Uzbek has around 5 million speakers in Afghanistan, yet differs from Northern Uzbek in phonology, lexicon and orthography enough that existing systems fail on it. We built a 997-sentence evaluation set and nearly 40,000 parallel pairs from dictionaries, literature and the web, trained a translation model, and added a post-processing step for Arabic-script word boundaries. All of it is openly available.

projects.title: neurograd
projects.description: A deep learning framework inspired by Karpathy's micrograd. It implements reverse-mode automatic differentiation over a dynamically built DAG, extending scalar micrograd-style autodiff to vectors, and includes a minimal neural-network library with a PyTorch-like API. Install it with `pip install neurograd-vec`.

projects.title: Uzbek Speech Models
projects.description: End-to-end Uzbek speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines, built by fine-tuning Whisper-Medium and SpeechT5 on a single NVIDIA T4. The STT model reaches 20% WER from only 10 hours of speech data — a useful result for how little supervision a low-resource language usually has.

experience.description: Research on NLP and MT, plus large-scale data pipelines. Implemented Contrastive Preference Optimization (CPO) fine-tuning, raising COMET score over the baseline. Built an end-to-end parallel data mining pipeline that aligns sentences from literary translations via LaBSE cosine similarity, deployed on GCP.

Real-time computer vision for object and action detection, using YOLO, MobileNet and ViT on video streams. Designed a Laplacian-variance classifier that tells smoke apart from a fogged camera lens, for live visual quality assessment. Also built the Uzbek STT and TTS pipelines above.

Built a RAG chatbot with caching that cut mean response time from 5 seconds to 2. Developed an image-based invoice parsing system by fine-tuning Donut and deploying it on AWS EC2, and engineered the FastAPI back-end serving every ML pipeline.

education.description: Recipient of the Presidential scholarship, covering full undergraduate tuition. Coursework in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Numerical Methods, Probability & Statistics and Linear Algebra.
